injuries.name: Andre Burakovsky
injuries.note: Burakovsky has yet to join his teammates on the ice since getting hurt in late October, but this is a positive step in the right direction for the 31-year-old winger. In his eight appearances this year, Burakovsky has yet to register a point, recording four blocks, three hits and three shots while averaging just 11:00 of ice time, a career-low mark.

injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Foegele has been sidelined since late October, and he initially carried a return timetable of 3-4 weeks. While he hasn't yet entered that window, the fact that he hasn't yet resumed skating suggests that he isn't particularly close to returning to game action. A better idea of the 30-year-old's timetable to return will likely come into focus once he's cleared to return to the ice.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.

injuries.name: Jakub Dvorak
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Los Angeles Kings placed D Jakub Dvorak on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Erik Gustafsson
injuries.note: Upper Body: Gustafsson will not return to Saturday's (Nov. 21) game against Senators due to an upper-body injury.

injuries.name: Trevor Moore
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Moore isn't expected to play against Ottawa on Saturday (Nov. 21), according to Zach Dooley of LA Kings Insider.

injuries.name: Artemi Panarin
injuries.note: Personal: Panarin is Out for Saturday's (Nov. 21) game against the Senators.

injuries.name: Andre Burakovsky
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Ottawa Senators said that Burakovsky was on the ice on Friday (Nov. 20) doing some individual drills, per Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Ankle: The Ottawa Senators said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Eklund is expected to miss the next 10-12 weeks.

injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Knee: The Ottawa Senators said that Foegele hasn't resumed skating as of Monday (Nov. 16).

injuries.name: Hayden Hodgson
injuries.note: Groin: Hodgson won't play Saturday (Nov. 21) versus the Kings, per the NHL media site.
